subject: red-team: the judge's falsification method as pinned bytes

cases.note: Every tie in the live bundle holds: clauses to kernel, catalogue to toolkit, prose to diagnostics, receipts to producer, lifecycle to its own references.
Every planted hollowing and schema control in the validator selftest reds exactly one tie, bounded on both sides by the positive arm and the residue arm.
A boundary run over the wave-17 artifacts reproduces the all-exit gate vacuity and a blind-observer case from catalogue plus toolkit alone, and every finding it emits satisfies the schema.
The planted negative control: a non-vacuous clean bundle yields 'no findings', which is the honest steady state.
A class whose gate landed leaves active sampling while its experiment still finds the instance directly, so the lifecycle field is distinguishable from a broken detector.
The committed run-ledger record is exactly what the fixture run produces, so the curve reads measurements rather than typed numbers.
The experiment block drops verbatim into an issue body's observer-demonstration section and passes the admission completeness dry-run.
The committed receipts.json is exactly what its producer renders from the catalogue, twice.
The planted negative control for the BUILD refusal: a class naming its adjudication enters the catalogue.
BUILD fold-in behind the landed ed3c/skill-concerns#93 gate: a catalogue class is an enforcement shape, so it cannot enter without a cure-authorization.
A SHADOW detection named as the authorization is refused by name: detection is the beginning of adjudication, never a licence to legislate the catalogue.
A finding with no observed half, and one with prose where a command belongs, both fail the schema the validator owns.
The same block inside a fence arrives at the consumer's admission gate as an empty section, which is why the grammar carries no fence.
An escalation citing a class outside the bounded urgent list is a validator error rather than a louder signal.
A planted provider-mutating call in a driver fixture copy turns the forbidden-surface scan red; the reader property is a tested surface, not a promise.
A gated catalogue entry with no gate reference reds: who legislated the class must be a readback, never archaeology.
A class with no provenance receipt, or whose falsification recipe is prose rather than a runnable command sequence, fails the validator.
Deleting one L0 kernel entry breaks the count tie with the clauses.
A factually harmless hand edit to receipts.json still reds: evidence regenerates through its producer.
A pass whose bundle digest moved refuses its own report rather than publishing findings read off a tree something mutated underneath it.
Three post-admission waves without a falling recurrence is a finding about the architecture; two waves is not-yet-evidence rather than a green.

A recipe naming a flag absent from shadow_driver.build_parser() reds. COMMAND_RE certifies that a step looks like a command; only the real parser certifies that it runs, and a runnable-command-sequence field that certifies unrunnable sequences is the opinion registry the field exists to prevent.

A method_claims entry with no authorization reds with the repository's own BUILD_CURE_UNAUTHORIZED: the catalogue's non-detector grounds carry the same who-adjudicated-this readback every other grounded thing here carries.
A run_id that is a label rather than the producer's ISO-8601 instant reds, and so does a record inserted before the one preceding it.

The no-filing property covers every script in the bundle: a module that imports subprocess reds even when it contains no provider verb, which is the form of the check that can cover the scanner itself.

A named boundary term that resolves to no bytes in the tree reds. Successor to the absent-neighbour exit, which expired when shadow-architect landed (ed3c/skill-concerns#75) and was removed rather than left standing - an exit with no expiry is the free-exit class this bundle catalogues, aimed at itself.

Every duplicate-discovery finding's subject.sha256 is recomputed from the file at subject.path. A digest-binding monitor publishing the digest of its own fingerprint string binds nothing at the path it names.
Detection and acquittal read the same bytes. A diff whose unchanged context merely mentions the word falsification does not exculpate the threshold it adds.

The fixture generation-close bundle produces one run record with subject kind noodles-generation-close, one finding in the admitted schema, and an unmoved bundle digest; the committed record is exactly what that run produces.
The planted negative arm at the station: a clean bundle yields no findings and still appends its run record, so a silent station is distinguishable from an absent one.

A class marked gated with its gate reference is absent from the very next run's classes_sampled list, read back off the run record rather than off the filter; the same fixture with the class still active samples it and finds the instance.
The station's runbook pointer resolves to a document naming the step and the ledger that is its completion receipt; deleting that document reds.
Every register row's sensor names bytes this tree can open holding the phrase the row cites, every row carries an escalation trigger and path, and the GATED seed row names its gate.
A run record whose subject names a station domain/observation-topology.json does not carry reds; the subject vocabulary is the topology's ids and never a second list.
An arrival row carrying a run-kind receipt while every record for that station came from a fixture reds; the station reaches production only when the record and the receipt arrive together.
Each of the four required fields is proven load-bearing on its own: dropping the gap, the honest reason, the sensor or the escalation reds the register.
A ceiling admitted in this bundle's prose - in a document or in a script - with no register row named on the line reds. An admitted gap watched by nothing is an exemption with better manners.

Both directions of the fired status: a row saying the escalation landed while escalation.landed names no provider ref reds, and a landed ref on a row still marked OPEN reds the other way. A status is a claim about a filed tightening, and the ref is what makes it a readback.

Both live method_claims rows name a pinned subject that exists and that their own ref repeats, plus an adjudication issue that is also one of the claim's refs; the wave-19 judge's exact garbage ref is refused on the same call.
An adjudication issue that is not among the claim's refs reds: existence-checked means the cadence sweep re-resolves the artifact, not that the ref parses.
R7 exits non-zero. A finding printed on stdout at status 0 is prose no caller consumes; the run itself is clean, so the status can only have come from the curve.
